name: HyperliquidX 0.1.0
body:
HyperliquidX 0.1.0

Initial native macOS release, supporting Apple Silicon and Intel on macOS 14 or later.

The Release DMG workflow builds and verifies the installer, uploads it to the Cloudflare R2 hyperliquidx bucket and updates the download link at https://hypexapp.xyz after validating the public checksum.

This build uses ad-hoc signing and is not Apple notarized. If macOS blocks the first launch, users who trust the download can use System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.

The application remains in active development. Real wallet, exchange lifecycle and native interaction acceptance are still pending; build and service tests do not establish mainnet trading readiness.

Public issue tracker: https://github.com/hyperliquidxapp/HyperliquidX/issues

### SHA-256

```text
d57299139fcd0edb7dadd3f19d4abe4bcc3cfaf1f52c50e4c5a6a7dec03d5e12  HyperliquidX-0.1.0.dmg
```

Verify the downloaded installer in Terminal:

```sh
shasum -a 256 ~/Downloads/HyperliquidX-0.1.0.dmg
```

Drag HyperliquidX into Applications and launch it there.
If macOS blocks the first launch and you trust this download, use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.

Use the DMG installer above. GitHub’s automatic “Source code” archives contain only the public issue tracker’s materials, not the application source.
